description: FIND-014 PARTIAL CLOSURE + FIND-019 NOT CLOSED. is_allowed_sentinel_removal_call() exists and the function-level allowlist contract is unit-tested, BUT no AST walker or grep test SCANS the actual production source files to flag any call site that .unlink() or os.remove() targets .dormant.sentinel from outside the 2 allowed callers. The verification claim in FIND-014 ('static-analysis (AST + grep) over .dormant.sentinel unlink sites') is satisfied at the API contract but NOT at the codebase scan level. Similarly, FIND-019 test_auto_merge_function_does_not_exist STILL only checks hasattr 'auto_merge' as a literal string — a renamed function like pr_merge / do_merge / force_merge would bypass it. No subprocess-AST scan for 'gh pr merge' or similar invocation strings outside annotate_pr was added.

evidence.snippet:
def test_auto_merge_function_does_not_exist():
    """Static-analysis-level: lib.bot2bot has NO auto_merge function."""
    import lib.bot2bot
    assert not hasattr(lib.bot2bot, "auto_merge"), \
        "auto_merge is SCOPE-DEFERRED to sprint-3 per FIND-003 critical"
